resources.string: Shows the next stop on top of other apps (your game). All computation is local: no network, no injection, no reading the game process.

Aggressive battery savers may kill the panel. If it disappears after a while, whitelist this app for autostart / background running and set its battery policy to unrestricted:

· Xiaomi / Redmi: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Permissions → Autostart; Battery and performance → App battery saver → No restrictions
· Huawei / Honor: Settings → App launch → turn off Manage automatically → allow Auto-launch / Secondary launch / Run in background
· OPPO / realme: App management → Power saving management → allow full background behaviour / auto launch
· vivo / iQOO: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → allow high background power; also enable floating window under permission management
· Samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps
This app is already exempt from battery optimization.

· Drag the panel by the thin bar at its top; tap that bar to switch between expanded and collapsed.
· The panel never takes input focus, so the game stays fully playable outside it; the trade-off is that you cannot type inside the panel — recording, export and import all live on the full page.
· If notification permission is denied the foreground-service notification stays out of the shade (the service still runs); the system running-apps view still lists it and can stop it.
· Progress is kept both on this device and inside the panel page; uninstalling clears it. Use Export / Import on the full page to move progress between devices.
